content: File created successfully at: /tmp/mte-ed-migration-typo-0zgbz9lc/ledgerline/migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

I fixed the typo with a new migration and left `0007_add_customers.sql` alone. A project note says migrations that are already in production must never be edited; changes go in a new numbered file instead. If I had edited 0007 directly, databases that already ran it would keep the column as `emial`, while new databases would get `email`.

The new file is `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

`emial` doesn't appear anywhere else in the repo, so no code or tests needed updating. I haven't run the migration against a database.
